content.text:
The admin page and 403 handling are in place. Here's what was added:

## Summary

### 1. **`next.config.ts`** – enable auth boundary
Enabled the experimental `authInterrupts` option so `forbidden()` works and returns a 403 status.

### 2. **`app/admin/page.tsx`** – admin page with role check
- Uses `verifyAdmin()` from your auth library to read the session
- Calls `forbidden()` when the user is not an admin or has no session
- Renders the admin dashboard when the user has the admin role

### 3. **`app/admin/forbidden.tsx`** – 403 error page
- Custom 403 page with a dark gradient background
- Shows a clear “Access Forbidden” message
- Includes a “Return to Home” link

With the current mock auth (which always returns `role: 'user'`), visiting `/admin` returns a 403 and shows the forbidden page. To test admin access, change the mock in `app/lib/auth.ts` to return `role: 'admin'`.

## Summary

### 1. **`next.config.ts`** – enable auth boundary
Enabled the experimental `authInterrupts` option so `forbidden()` works and returns a 403 status.

### 2. **`app/admin/page.tsx`** – admin page with role check
- Uses `verifyAdmin()` from your auth library to read the session
- Calls `forbidden()` when the user is not an admin or has no session

### 3. **`app/admin/forbidden.tsx`** – 403 error page

- Shows a clear “Access Forbidden” message

With the current mock auth (which always returns `role: 'user'`), visiting `/admin` returns a 403 and shows the forbidden page. To test admin access, change the mock in `app/lib/auth.ts` to return `role: 'admin'`.
